mergedParams.userDescription: Elegant wipe reveal, text painted on by a smooth, invisible line. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Elegant Wipe Reveal with Smooth Painted Text Animation

prompts.prompt: Create an elegant wipe reveal preset where text appears as if painted on by an invisible brush stroke moving from left to right. Think of it like a cinematic title reveal where each word emerges through a smooth, organic mask transition - similar to how a brush would reveal text on canvas in After Effects. The reveal should feel fluid and artistic, with each word having a subtle stagger. Use a clip-path animation that sweeps across each word with a soft edge, creating the illusion of paint being applied. The text should have a slight opacity fade during the reveal for added elegance. Consider adding a subtle blur-to-sharp transition as the text is revealed to enhance the painting effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: Use BaseLayout with 'flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2' for word layout. Each word should be wrapped in its own BaseLayout with 'relative overflow-hidden' containing a TextAtom. Implement the wipe effect using a generic keyframe effect on clipPath property, animating from 'inset(0 100% 0 0)' to 'inset(0 0 0 0)' with ease-out easing over 0.8s per word. Add a secondary opacity effect from 0.7 to 1 and blur effect from 2 to 0 pixels during the same duration. Use caption data for word-level timing with a 0.1s stagger between words. Set containerProps.className to 'w-full h-full' and use fitDurationTo: 'children' to match the total animation duration. Performance: Use transform: translateZ(0) on text containers to promote GPU layers.

prompts.prompt: Design a typography kinetics preset that reveals text through a smooth horizontal line sweep, as if an invisible marker is drawing across the screen. Imagine a minimalist motion graphics approach where a thin, elegant line moves across the frame and text materializes in its wake. The line should have a subtle glow or light trail effect, and text should appear with a gentle scale-up animation from 0.95 to 1.0 as it's revealed. Think of it as a high-end broadcast graphics package where timing is everything - the reveal should feel deliberate and sophisticated, not rushed.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Create a two-layer structure: BaseLayout container with 'absolute inset-0' containing both the sweep line (ShapeAtom as a thin rectangle with 'h-1 bg-white/80') and text layer. Animate the line using translateX from -100% to 100% of viewport width over 2s with ease-in-out. Text layer uses BaseLayout with 'flex flex-col items-start justify-center px-12' containing TextAtom components. Apply a mask gradient effect using CSS linear-gradient in containerProps.style that follows the line position. Each text element should have a generic effect combining scale (0.95 to 1) and opacity (0 to 1) triggered when the line passes through, using intersection timing calculations. Add a subtle glow effect using textShadow: '0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,0.3)' that fades in. Use internal effect preset 'fade-in' as a base and extend with custom scale animation.

prompts.prompt: Develop a paint stroke reveal where text appears through animated brush strokes that build up the letters progressively. Think of rotoscoped animation where each letter is revealed through multiple overlapping paint strokes - like watching an artist paint calligraphy in real-time. The strokes should have varying opacity and slight rotation variations to feel organic and hand-painted. This is similar to the text animations in artistic title sequences where typography becomes part of the visual narrative.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure with BaseLayout using 'relative w-full h-full' containing multiple mask layers. Create 3-4 ShapeAtom elements per word positioned absolutely with varying rotations (-5deg to 5deg) using 'absolute' positioning and transform rotate. Animate these shapes using scaleX from 0 to 1 with different timing offsets (0.1s apart) and spring easing for organic movement. Text uses TextAtom with 'relative z-10' and applies a composite mask from all shape layers. Implement using SVG clipPath with animated path morphing for more complex brush shapes. Add subtle texture using filter: 'contrast(1.1) brightness(1.05)'. Use repeatChildrenProps to apply consistent styling across multiple text elements. Consider using a sub-preset for individual brush stroke animations that can be composed together.

prompts.prompt: Create a liquid wipe effect where text is revealed as if being painted by flowing liquid mercury. Visualize this as a premium commercial effect where the reveal has weight and viscosity - the text doesn't just appear, it flows into existence with realistic physics. The wipe should have a slightly irregular edge that undulates as it moves, creating an organic, fluid motion. Add subtle reflections and highlights that travel across the text surface as it's revealed, simulating metallic paint properties.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative overflow-hidden w-full h-full bg-black' containing TextAtom elements. Apply a custom SVG filter for the liquid edge using feTurbulence and feDisplacementMap for organic distortion. Animate using a combination of clipPath with a complex polygon path and mask-image with a gradient. Create the metallic effect using multiple text-shadow layers and a moving linear-gradient background that simulates light reflection. Use generic effects to animate: clipPath from polygon points creating irregular edge, backgroundPosition for traveling highlight (-200% to 200%), and opacity with slight overshoot (0 to 1.1 to 1). Timing should use cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) for fluid motion. Add ShapeAtom overlays with 'mix-blend-mode: screen' for additional highlight effects.

prompts.prompt: Design a typewriter-style paint reveal but instead of typical character-by-character appearance, each letter is painted on with a smooth brush motion. Think of it as combining vintage typewriter aesthetics with modern kinetic typography - each character space gets filled with an elegant paint stroke animation. The effect should maintain the rhythmic, mechanical timing of a typewriter but with fluid, artistic reveals for each letter. Add subtle ink splatter particles when each letter completes for added dynamism.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with 'flex flex-wrap' for character layout. Each character wrapped in BaseLayout with 'relative w-8 h-12 overflow-hidden'. Implement paint stroke using ShapeAtom with animated scaleY from 0 to 1.2 to 1 (overshoot for paint splash effect). TextAtom uses 'absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center' with opacity tied to stroke animation completion. Create ink splatter using multiple small ShapeAtom elements with 'absolute rounded-full bg-current' positioned randomly around each letter, animated with scale and opacity effects. Use caption data to get individual character timing if available, otherwise calculate based on consistent 0.1s intervals. Add subtle shake effect (translateX/Y ±2px) on impact. Consider using internal 'typewriter' effect preset as base and extending with paint stroke animations. Performance: use will-change: 'transform, opacity' on animated elements.

prompts.prompt: Develop a calligraphy brush reveal where text appears as if being written by an expert calligrapher with varying stroke pressure and speed. The animation should capture the elegance of Asian brush painting where the brush lifts and presses, creating thick and thin strokes. Each word should have a unique flow pattern that follows natural handwriting motion. The reveal should include subtle ink bleeding effects at stroke intersections and a slight paper texture interaction.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-50 to-gray-100' for paper texture. Use SVG paths for each word stored in presetExecution, animated with stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset technique. TextAtom positioned absolutely with opacity linked to path completion. Implement variable stroke width using multiple overlapping paths with different stroke-width values (2px to 8px) and slight timing offsets. Add ink bleed effect using blurred ShapeAtom elements at predetermined points with 'filter: blur(4px)' and opacity animation. Use transform-origin manipulation to create natural brush lifting motion (slight rotation and scale changes). Apply subtle textShadow for ink depth. Consider fetching calligraphy path data from server if available. Timing should vary between 0.5s to 1.2s per word based on complexity, using ease-in-out for natural brush movement.

prompts.prompt: Create a prismatic wipe effect where text is revealed through a rainbow light sweep that paints each word with shifting colors before settling to the final color. Think of it as a combination of light painting photography and kinetic typography - the reveal should feel like pure light energy materializing the text. The wipe should have chromatic aberration effects at the leading edge and leave a subtle trail of color that quickly fades.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full bg-black overflow-hidden'. Create light sweep using gradients: linear-gradient with animated background-position and hue-rotate filter. TextAtom components use 'relative z-10' with initial opacity: 0. Implement chromatic aberration using three duplicate text layers with 'absolute' positioning, each with different color channels (red, green, blue) via mix-blend-mode and slight position offsets (translateX: -1px, 0, 1px). Animate using generic effects: hue-rotate from 0deg to 360deg to 0deg, opacity from 0 to 1, and custom filter combining blur(2px) to blur(0). Add trailing glow using textShadow animation from '0 0 30px currentColor' to '0 0 0 transparent'. Use mask-image with moving linear-gradient for the actual wipe effect. Consider audio-reactive waveform effects if music is present to sync color changes with beats.

prompts.prompt: Design a particle formation reveal where text appears to be painted on by thousands of tiny particles coalescing into letterforms. Imagine a sand art animation where particles flow and settle to form text - each word builds up from scattered dots that gravitate toward their final positions. The particles should have slight physics-based movement with momentum and deceleration. This creates a magical, ethereal quality perfect for epic titles or mystical content.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full'. Generate particle positions using helper function in presetExecution that creates 50-100 points per word. Each particle is a ShapeAtom with 'absolute w-1 h-1 rounded-full' with randomized starting positions (using Math.random() for x/y offsets). Animate particles using generic effects with custom bezier curves for physics simulation: translateX/Y from random positions to final positions within letter bounds, scale from 0 to 1, opacity from 0.3 to 1. TextAtom starts with opacity: 0 and reveals at 70% of particle animation completion. Add subtle glow to particles using boxShadow. Stagger particle animations using Array.map with index-based delays (index * 0.01s). Use blur effect on fast-moving particles (blur increases with velocity). Consider using Web Animations API through custom JavaScript in containerProps.style for more complex physics if needed.

prompts.prompt: Create a neon sign paint-on effect where text appears as if being drawn with glowing neon light. The reveal should simulate the flickering and warming up of neon tubes - starting dim and unstable, then brightening to full luminosity. Each word segment should feel like it's being energized sequentially, with realistic neon glow and slight electrical flickering. This evokes the aesthetic of cyberpunk titles or retro 80s motion graphics.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full bg-gray-900'. TextAtom uses custom font weight (minimum 600) with 'text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 to-purple-500'. Create neon glow using multiple text-shadow layers: '0 0 10px rgba(236,72,153,0.8), 0 0 20px rgba(236,72,153,0.6), 0 0 30px rgba(236,72,153,0.4), 0 0 40px rgba(168,85,247,0.2)'. Implement flicker using rapid opacity changes: keyframes at [0, 0.1, 0, 1, 0.9, 1] over 0.3s with step timing. Paint-on effect uses clipPath animation from left to right with irregular polygon points to simulate tube segments. Add ShapeAtom behind text as neon tube backing with 'bg-gray-800 rounded-full' and slight larger dimensions. Use generic effects for: brightness (0.5 to 1.2), contrast (1 to 1.5), and custom CSS filter 'drop-shadow(0 0 15px currentColor)'. Consider adding audio-reactive waveform effects for glow intensity if music is present.

prompts.prompt: Develop a watercolor wash reveal where text appears as if being painted with wet watercolor brushes that blend and bleed naturally. The effect should capture the unpredictability of watercolor - with color pooling, edge bleeding, and transparency variations. Each word should feel hand-painted with overlapping washes that create depth and artistic imperfection. The reveal should include paper texture interaction where paint appears to soak into the surface.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' and textured background using CSS gradient layers. Create watercolor effect using multiple overlapping BaseLayout containers per word with 'absolute' positioning and varying opacity (0.3 to 0.8). Each wash layer uses ShapeAtom with irregular SVG path shapes (generated using bezier curves with random control points). Animate using scale from center (0.8 to 1.1 to 1) and opacity (0 to varied final values) with different timing per layer. TextAtom appears through accumulated mask of all wash layers. Add paper texture interaction using mix-blend-mode: 'multiply' on wash layers and 'color-burn' on text. Implement color bleeding using filter: 'blur(2px) contrast(0.9) saturate(1.2)' on wash edges. Use transform-origin variations for organic scaling. Create wet paint effect by animating filter values: blur from 4px to 1px, brightness from 1.2 to 1. Consider using sub-presets for individual wash animations. Add subtle turbulence filter for realistic edge distortion. Timing should be slow and organic (1.5-2s per word) with ease-in-out curves.
